title: Neutralize an Acid with a Base
description: Perform a classical acid-base titration using hydrochloric acid and sodium hydroxide to achieve a neutral pH of 7.
objective: Mix hydrochloric acid and sodium hydroxide carefully until the solution reaches neutral pH (7.0).
hints: Add universal indicator to monitor color change from red to green.
Add sodium hydroxide drop by drop as you get closer to pH 7.

title: Observe Gas Evolution from Baking Soda & Acid
description: Investigate how sodium bicarbonate reacts with acid to produce carbon dioxide gas effervescence.
objective: Add sodium bicarbonate powder to acetic acid and observe the generation of carbon dioxide gas bubbles.
hints: Use the spatula to add sodium bicarbonate into the beaker containing vinegar.

title: Form a White Silver Chloride Precipitate
description: Combine clear silver nitrate and sodium chloride solutions to synthesize insoluble silver chloride solid.
objective: Mix silver nitrate solution with sodium chloride solution to form a dense white precipitate.
hints: Add a few drops of silver nitrate solution into the sodium chloride solution test tube.

name: Barium Sulfate Cloud Formation
title: Detect Sulfate Ions using Barium Chloride
description: Test for sulfate ions by reacting barium chloride with sulfuric acid to create insoluble white barium sulfate precipitate.
objective: Produce a milky white precipitate of barium sulfate by combining barium chloride and sulfuric acid.
hints: Barium chloride is a specific analytical reagent for detecting sulfate ions.

title: Displace Copper from Solution using Zinc
description: Demonstrate the metal activity series by placing zinc granules into blue copper sulfate solution.
objective: Observe the blue solution decolorize while reddish copper metal deposits on the zinc.
hints: Zinc is more reactive than copper and donates electrons to Cu2+ ions.

title: Perform the Elephant Toothpaste Catalyzed Decomposition
description: Decompose hydrogen peroxide solution rapidly using potassium iodide as a catalyst.
objective: Trigger rapid oxygen gas foam release and observe exothermic heat production.
hints: Potassium iodide lowers the activation energy for H2O2 decomposition.

title: Generate Hydrogen Gas with Acid and Magnesium
description: React active magnesium metal ribbon with hydrochloric acid to generate flammable hydrogen gas.
objective: Evolve hydrogen gas bubbles by adding magnesium ribbon into hydrochloric acid solution.
hints: Watch the test tube warm up as hydrogen bubbles off rapidly.

title: Indicator Rainbow: Pink Phenolphthalein Shift
description: Use phenolphthalein to detect basic conditions created by adding sodium hydroxide.
objective: Turn a clear solution into vibrant pink by making it basic with sodium hydroxide in the presence of phenolphthalein.
hints: Phenolphthalein is colorless in acidic or neutral solutions and pink above pH 8.2.

title: Detect Carbon Dioxide Gas using Limewater
description: Pass generated carbon dioxide gas into clear limewater to observe precipitation of calcium carbonate.
objective: Turn clear limewater cloudy by reacting it with carbon dioxide gas.
hints: Limewater contains dissolved calcium hydroxide which precipitates as calcium carbonate.

title: Investigate Endothermic Dissolution with Ammonium Chloride
description: Measure the temperature drop when solid ammonium chloride dissolves in water.
objective: Dissolve ammonium chloride in water and record a temperature decrease of at least 5 °C.
hints: Stir the mixture continuously while keeping the thermometer probe immersed.

title: Investigate Exothermic Dissolution with Calcium Chloride
description: Observe and measure heat release when anhydrous calcium chloride dissolves in water.
objective: Dissolve calcium chloride solid in water and measure a temperature increase of at least 10 °C.
hints: Hydration of calcium ions releases significant thermal energy.

title: Prepare Copper Sulfate from Insoluble Oxide
description: Dissolve black copper(II) oxide powder in warm sulfuric acid to create bright blue copper sulfate solution.
objective: Heat sulfuric acid with black copper oxide until the black powder dissolves into a blue solution.
hints: Warm the acid gently on the hot plate to speed up the reaction with the solid oxide.

title: Split Water molecules via Electrolysis
description: Use electrical direct current to decompose water molecules into hydrogen and oxygen gas gases.
objective: Generate hydrogen and oxygen gas bubbles at electrical electrodes in acidified water.
hints: Sulfuric acid acts as an electrolyte to increase electrical conductivity.

title: Observe Direct Phase Change: Iodine Sublimation
description: Gently heat solid dark iodine crystals on a hot plate to produce vibrant purple gas vapor.
objective: Heat iodine solid until purple iodine gas vapors fill the container without liquid formation.
hints: Solid iodine converts directly to gas at atmospheric pressure upon heating.

title: Redox Decolorization of Permanganate
description: Oxidize hydrogen peroxide with potassium permanganate in acidic solution and observe purple color discharge.
objective: Discharge the deep purple color of permanganate to clear solution by adding hydrogen peroxide.
hints: Permanganate ions (MnO4-) are reduced to colorless Mn2+ ions in acidic solution.
